title: 天命所歸
intro:

On May 29, 2026, "Sovereign Destiny" was solely composed by His Imperial Highness Prince Li Junxian, and premiered on June 1, 2026—the coronation day—at the Royal Concert Hall as a prestigious ceremonial music piece crafted specifically for the Empress's sacred title conferment ceremony during her ascension. The entire composition strictly embraces the extreme philosophy of "Cinematic Brutalism," thoroughly abandoning the melodies, chords, and intricate rhythms of secular music. title: 黃名帝國不凋的玫瑰
englishTitle: The Unfading Rose of Wongming Empire
intro:
2025年12月22日，由李君羨親王殿下與皇家宮廷樂師首席索諾攜手完成。這首樂曲《黃名帝國不凋的玫瑰》謹獻給女皇陛下。

「不凋」之名，寓意慶寧女皇的輝煌治世如永世綻放的玫瑰一般，任憑歲月流轉，其榮光與權柄始終永恆不朽。

慶寧女皇（Empress Qingning）是黃名帝國乃至整個中文微國家中在位時間最長的君主。她的統治不僅象徵著帝國的黃金時代，更體現了至高無上的權力與無盡的榮耀。

以下是她的正式完整頭銜，彰顯其無可撼動的地位：

黃名帝國以及屬地與附屬國唯一的合法女皇、尼子原人與黃名先民的女王、萬頃之地的女領主、黎明的首生者、全國境的守護者、護正法者、最勝者、萬王之上的皇帝、統御星辰的、身披日光的、千陽女皇、諸神加冕的、極地與沙海的繼承人、金黃收穫的雌獅、四風主宰、勝利與征服之母、東方的馭龍者、馬亨德王。

Completed on December 22, 2025, by His Imperial Highness Prince Li Junxian and Chief Royal Court Musician Sonor, this musical piece, "The Unfading Rose of Wongming Empire," is humbly dedicated to Her Imperial Majesty.

The name "The Unfading Rose" signifies that the glorious reign of Empress Qingning blooms eternally like an everlasting rose, defying the passage of time with immortal radiance and authority.

Empress Qingning is the longest-reigning monarch of the Wongming Empire and indeed the entire Chinese micronational community. Her rule not only symbolizes the Golden Age of the Empire, but also embodies supreme power and endless glory.

The following are her formal, full titles, which highlight her unshakeable status:

The Sole Legitimate Empress of the Wongming Empire and its Territories and Dependencies, Queen of the Nizi, the Primal Kin, and the Wongming Forerunners, Lady of the Myriad Acres, The Firstborn of the Dawn, The Protector of the Entire Imperial Domain, The Protector of the Dharma, The Sarvottama, The Emperor Over All Monarchs, The Astrocrator, The Sun-Clad Sovereign, The Empress of the Thousand Suns, The Deified Coronet, The Heiress to the Frigid Poles and the Endless Sands, The Lioness of the Golden Harvest, The Sovereign of the Four Winds, The Mother of Victory and Conquest, The Dragon-Rider of the Eastern Realms, Mahendra.
